rv.q: As an experience to just wash over you and let the moments that strike you strike you, The Kick Inside has its pleasures.
This is live theater at its absolute best.
The Kick Inside feels completely random; it has aliens, a talking canine, milkshakes, and innards.

cn.t: This experimental movement piece inspired by Kate Bush divides critics: some praise its bold rejection of conventional narrative, while others find its avant-garde repetition more random than revelatory.
